authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full pattra explicitly gives Punjabi pattā/pattrā, Awankari pattar, Bshk paλ, Gawri phaṭa, Shina Kohistani păṭhṷ and Kotgarhi pāc leaf; it also documents pattrikā and Middle Indo-Aryan pattī/pattikā leaf. These support the selected simple and ordinary local leaf variants. Source aspiration, dental/retroflex notation, vowels, rhotics, affricates and ordinary endings remain intact, including complete same-family slash responses. Exact local phonetic/ending histories and cross-IA transmission remain qualified; nasal pānṭ- and other competing leaf families are excluded. Exact response: potṛo.
